fields.label: Enable Medusa Sync
fields.description: Master toggle. When off, the webhook receiver returns 200 immediately without dispatching, and the wallet-sync endpoints throw a friendly 'sync disabled' error.

fields.label: Medusa Webhook Secret
fields.description: HMAC-SHA256 key. Inbound POSTs to /api/method/polemarch.api.medusa_webhook.receive must carry x-medusa-signature computed over the raw body. Must equal the same secret in Medusa's ErpnextSetting.webhook_secret.

fields.label: Fixed Fee per Pay-in
fields.description: Cashfree (or whichever gateway) charges this flat amount per successful wallet deposit. The company bears it as an expense — the customer's wallet credit is NOT reduced by the fee.

fields.label: GST Rate on Fee
fields.description: GST applied on top of the fixed fee. 18% standard for facilitation services. India Compliance reads the GST-input account during GSTR-2 filing.

fields.label: Fee Expense Account
fields.description: Where the gateway fee net-of-GST hits. P&L expense — typically under Indirect Expenses. India Compliance picks this up in GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B.

fields.label: GST Input Account
fields.description: Input GST credit on the fee. Asset (current) account. Usually 'Input Tax IGST' or similar from the standard India Compliance CoA.

fields.label: Bank Account (Fee Outflow)
fields.description: Where the fee + GST is deducted from. Usually the same operating bank account that receives the customer's deposit. Cashfree typically settles net-of-fee (deposit credit minus fee) into this account.

fields.label: Operator Notes
fields.description: Free-form. E.g., 'switched from Cashfree to Razorpay on 2026-06-01, fee schedule changed to ₹15 + 18% GST'.
